detached_structure.evidence: The lot at center has two roofed structures: a gray-roofed building at the top of a long paved driveway and a larger gabled house just below it. It is unclear whether the upper one is a garage or a separate building.

signals.notes: The tile center is ambiguous between a flag-lot-style property with a long paved driveway and the house at lower center; heavy tree canopy shades most of the yard, and the roofs show some moss or staining and uneven tone.
